_comment_coords: run: python pick.py  -- it fills tap_a / tap_b
_comment_mode: concurrent = two taps as close together as the OS allows (~40-80ms apart). sequence = force an explicit gap; use this if the app needs to see A before B, or to look human.
_comment_lead: 生效的是 lead_ms_by_mode[mode]。2026-09-24 实测：sequence 约 51ms，concurrent 约 72ms。phone_minus_pc_ms 已废弃——发射误差改用设备端同一时钟的前后时间差计算，不再依赖任何跨时钟偏移（手机会自动校时而本机 W32Time 停用，存偏移必然过期）。
_comment_phone_off: phone_minus_pc_ms is written by probe.py; used only for reporting.
_comment_warm: the first `input` of the day pays a cold class-load. warm fires the same code path harmlessly (KEYCODE_UNKNOWN = no-op) a couple seconds before T. keep enabled unless it lags the bus.
_comment_stage: stage=true pre-writes the command body so only a 1-byte newline is written at T. turn off only to A/B test it.

end_to_end_send_to_inject_ms.note: measured 8-shot at lead=75: landing error -14.5..+4.9 => true cost 60..90ms

_comment_bias: 8-shot spread was -14.5..+4.9ms. +20 shifts the whole window late so even the worst shot lands after T. For 抢票 early=button not live yet=dead shot; late=~20ms is nearly free. Set to 0 if the target is first-come-first-served and rivals are also automated.
_comment_gap: 请求 40~60ms。实测该值散布约 30~70ms——单发 input 进程返回时刻本身有 ±20ms 抖动，与目标区间同量级，所以别追求更细。真实间隔看「3 标定」页的实测行。
_comment_times: 每行一个时刻；只写 HH:MM:SS 会自动算今天（已过则明天），也可写完整日期。到点按先后依次自动开火。
_comment_var: 单发 input 进程耗时实测 35~118ms，这是抖动的唯一来源：命中误差中位 ±10ms 但尾部到 ±65ms，两下间隔请求 40~60 实测 1~94。要压掉它只能换成设备常驻注入（uiautomator2 socket），不起进程。
